mapper.insert:
insert into order_detail (name, image, order_id, product_id, product_spec, number, amount) values
(#{od.name}, #{od.image}, #{od.orderId}, #{od.productId}, #{od.productSpec}, #{od.number}, #{od.amount})
mapper.select: select od.product_id as productId, p.name as productName, p.stock as currentStock, sum(od.number) as totalSales from order_detail od inner join orders o on od.order_id = o.id inner join product p on od.product_id = p.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time <= #{end} group by od.product_id, p.name, p.stock order by totalSales desc
